generic_domain.justification: Incremental learning is a broad concept that encompasses various forms of lifelong learning, including class-incremental learning. It refers to the ability of models to learn continuously over time without forgetting previously learned tasks or data. Class-incremental learning is a specific case under incremental learning where new classes are introduced incrementally. Therefore, choosing 'incremental learning' as the most generic domain makes sense because it can cover all aspects related to adding new information incrementally, whether it's classes, tasks, or domains.
